interface.signature: def search(S: str, pat: str) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: Both S and pat must be strings.
Length of S is between 1 and 10^5, and length of pat is between 1 and length of S.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(S) - len(pat) + 1 for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned indices are valid 1-based starting positions for pat in S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[index-1:index+len(pat)-1] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every returned index corresponds to a valid occurrence of pat in S.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(S) - len(pat) + 2) if S[i-1:i+len(pat)-1] == pat)
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly all 1-based starting indices of pat in S.
